variants.name: SlimePureSmall
variants.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit target: attached approved Pure Small pixel-art slime. Convert this ONE approved character into a production-ready TWO-LAYER SPRITE ATLAS on a truly transparent background. Output a wide 2:1 canvas consisting of TWO equal square cells, left and right, no grid lines or text. LEFT CELL: the exact approved slime body including its existing highlights, dark stepped outline, shading and any head/element ornament; REMOVE ALL eyes, mouth and pink cheeks, smoothly reconstruct the body colors underneath, so this body has absolutely NO face. RIGHT CELL: ONLY the removed eyes, smiling mouth and pink cheeks on pure transparency, with no body fill, no surrounding colored rectangle, no highlight or outline of a body. IMPORTANT REGISTRATION: both cells have exactly the same local coordinate grid; place each face feature at the exact position where it belongs on the left body when the right cell is overlaid on the left cell without scaling or shifting. Treat this as layer separation, not a redesign. Retain the reference's chunky pixel geometry, soft mint palette, silhouette width/height proportions, expression and feature spacing. Same scale in both cells. Fit the full body into the left square with generous transparent margins; no cropping. No duplicate body on the right, no extra face on the left, no labels, no checkerboard, no shadows, no floor. Real alpha transparency everywhere outside the intended painted parts.
